## Problem and result

Describe the trigger, the previous behavior, and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks that passed and the checks that did not run.
Give the reason for any missing required check.

## Review

- [ ] Session identity uses direct evidence.
- [ ] State and quota retain unknown and stale values.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation follows the writing policy.
- [ ] The change record matches the final implementation.
- [ ] Package and startup changes have installation and removal evidence.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials or private logs.
